description: This file defines the React context and provider component for handling user authentication via Supabase, including login, logout, and session management. It includes hooks for accessing auth state and user roles within a React application.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: React functional component that provides authentication context and manages auth state, including session initialization, login via email or Google OAuth, and logout.

methods.name: useAuth
methods.description: Custom hook to access the authentication context, providing user's session, user info, loading state, and auth functions.

methods.name: useRole
methods.description: Hook to retrieve the current user's role from metadata within the session.

methods.name: useSupabaseAuth
methods.description: Alias hook that returns the same value as useAuth for compatibility.
